description: News articles, most recently active first. Each article has a title, a summary, its countries, and the quorums (viewpoints with support counts) on its story. Filter by country. Costs $0.005 per article returned; an empty page is free. Needs the Quorumz API key on this connection (Authorization: Bearer <key>); the first 100 calls within 7 days are free.

country.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code, e.g. LB. Omit for the whole world.
country.title: Country

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page, to read older records. Omit for the newest.
cursor.title: Cursor

limit.description: Records per page, 1 to 50. Every record returned is charged.
limit.title: Limit

name: list_news
title: List news
